text:
alice: :rotating_light: noticing sustained P95 queueing on hosted eu1 pool-7 for the last 6m, admission control started emitting 429s to a subset of customers
ben: which customers? any correlation with model/seq len?
alice: mostly small internal test clients and a few embed-heavy tenants, qps sawtooth pattern every ~45s, p95 ~2.1s, p99 ~3.8s
carol: saw similar in the dashboard, heatmap shows hot nodes in pool-7 with high KV cache misses, could be image warmup churn
dave: can we rule out image pull/eviction churn? any kube-level OOMs or reboots?
alice: no reboots, no OOMs in the window, nodes are healthy but CPU on proxy side spikes at the same cadence, suspect connection stalls upstream
maria: putting quick filter on dashboard for tenant tag -> it's concentrated to 5 tenants, all using embeddings_small model with short seqlen but very bursty batched traffic
ben: that sounds like batching heuristic thrashing — small short requests batching to 1 then a flash to 16 then back, causing the admission signal to oscillate
carol: can we temp set per-tenant rate-limits to smooth? apply soft-alloc or backoff via delta-routing?
sre-oncall: I can push a temporary soft-cap at the API gateway for those tenant IDs, reduces p95 at cost of QPS for them. want me to do it now?
dave: do it, include a 30s ramp so it doesn't backfire. also disable aggressive autoscaler override for this pool while we investigate
infra-bot: deploy-gateway: rate-limit patch started for tenants [t-123,t-456,t-789], config-id cfg-202603, estimated ramp 30s
alice: thanks. can someone pull the admission controller logs for pool-7 and grep for "recompute-headroom" and "eviction" in the last 10m?
ben: grabbing logs now -> ```kubectl logs -n hosted admctrl-pool7-0 --since=10m | egrep "recompute-headroom|eviction|throttle"```
ben: admctrl shows repeated headroom recompute every 40-50s and a handful of "throttle:soft" decisions for those tenants, no hard evictions
carol: suggests feedback loop between proxy latency and admctrl headroom calc. we should smooth the headroom step changes (increase cooldown)
dave: agree. also add a short TTL-based sticky routing to warm nodes for embeddings_small so KV cache stays hot for that workload
maria: quick query for cost impact? those tenants are low-dollar devs but noisy, might be worth a tenant-specific ingress fence instead of full pool changes
ben: created a dashboard tile showing per-tenant p95 vs admissions for pool-7: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/hosted/eu1-pool7-tenant-p95 (added source filter)
alice: awesome. after soft-cap and sticky routing, p95 dropped to ~600ms within 90s, admission throttle events reduced x8
sre-oncall: leaving soft-cap in place for 30m, will revert if not stable. open action items?
dave: 1) tune admctrl cooldown and headroom step size for pool-7, 2) implement short-lived sticky routing for embeddings_small, 3) add per-tenant smoothing rule in gateway, 4) run a 2h soak once changes applied
carol: I'll file infra-issue with proposed admctrl PR and simulation traces, assigning to @ben and @maria
ben: taking it, will add unit test for oscillation scenario and run sim on staging pool-3
infra-bot: incident-tracker: created INC-2026-041, severity: S3, owner: ben, related-resources: pool-7, gateways cfg-202603
alice: good sleuthing. one more ask: can product/CS be notified for the 5 tenants that saw 429s? i'd like them prepped in case they escalate
maria: I'll ping solutions and CS with a short note and the mitigation timeline
sre-oncall: monitoring: I'll add an alert for oscillation >3 cycles in 5m and a synthetic that exercises embeddings_small path
alice: solid. leaving notes here, will update if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
